name: search-tools
description: Keeps a tgrep (trigram-indexed grep) server alive only while a Claude Code session is using a large repo, reaps orphaned servers after crashes (Windows, Linux, macOS), runs tree searches via grep in Bash (grep -r) as rg and refuses the ones it cannot map (xargs grep), and ships a reference skill for tgrep / ast-grep / semble / ripgrep flags and gotchas.
